body: LEAD: Latency must be presented as product SLOs, not protocol guarantees: WSS cloud command-to-display-applied p50 <=150 ms, p95 <=300 ms, p99 <=750 ms; LAN/WebRTC optional fast path p50 <=75 ms, p95 <=150 ms; reconnect-to-authoritative-snapshot p95 <=2 s on a reachable network. Instrument every commandId from console monotonic send time until server-relayed display.applied on the same console clock; separately record server queue and display render durations. Do not claim WebRTC/WebTransport is inherently faster without deployment measurements. QUIC offers low-latency establishment/path migration at protocol level, not an application latency bound: https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9000.
summary: Measured latency SLOs, not transport promises
